title: 21st Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/21/3/2025).
Debate on the proposed State Budget for 2026 continues, under Rule 235 of the Parliament's Standing Orders.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was devoted to continuing the debate on the proposed 2026 State Budget.
